verdict.rationale: The docs say Bugbot analyzes every PR for bugs and security vulnerabilities, not just style. Cursor's own figures claim high effort finds 35% more bugs with an 80% resolution rate. Independent users corroborate this: one says it "finds genuine bugs most reviewers miss" with "almost none of its comments frivolous or wrong," and another calls it "shockingly effective at finding bugs," though one hands-on report describes it flip-flopping on a suggested fix. Missing for 10: specific evidence for the story's named bug classes (race conditions, logic errors, edge cases), and independent measurement of the false-positive versus style-nit ratio.
